name: 武林浩荡
english_name: Wu Lin Hao Dang (Jin Yong's Dream II)
english_description: Branded in-game as Jin Yong's Dream II / Wu Lin Hao Dang, this archive shares an evidently common codebase with this collection's tybxjh (Bi Xue Jiang Hu) — its master, security, and login daemons are nearly identical — and belongs to the same "Tianya" code family as several other archives here (xhcii, zxty, ffxymud, jhfy2, and others). It even rewrote one shared scene, the "Peak of the World" cliff-jump, with its own custom "jump" command — a variant later reused verbatim by this collection's yxjh.
